meta.name: Legado Salvaje
meta.description: Historias asombrosas de dedicación, ingenio y sacrificio mientras los padres del mundo animal se embarcan en el mayor de todos los desafíos.

videos.title: The Greatest Adventure
videos.overview: A journey like no other – full of moments of joy and danger. For animal parents in the wild, the stakes could not be higher, with success ensuring the future of life on our planet.

videos.title: Oceans
videos.overview: Parenting in the ocean is rare, and demands dedication and intelligence. From navigating the reef, to teaching their young to hunt giants, these parents have the most remarkable strategies on Earth.

videos.title: Grasslands
videos.overview: Parents must constantly balance risk and reward when raising young in open grasslands. Whilst abundant grass promises plentiful food and places to call home, this alone cannot guarantee success.

videos.title: Freshwater
videos.overview: Water is essential to all life on Earth but too much or too little can be disastrous. Parents must master timing, to overcome freshwater’s constant change and successfully raise the next generation.

videos.title: Jungles
videos.overview: Raising young in the complex world of jungles requires ingenuity. Parents must become masters of their environment and learn to exploit every opportunity through determination and teamwork.
